argv:
printf '__ARCH__
'; uname -m; printf '__MODEL__
'; cat /proc/device-tree/model; printf '
__CMDLINE__
'; cat /proc/cmdline; printf '__VERSION__
'; cat /proc/version; printf '__BUILD__
'; sed -n 's/^BUILD_ID=//p' /etc/os-release; printf '__BOOTID__
'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf '__UID__
'; id -u; __ab_rc=$?; printf '
__AB_RC__%d
' "$__ab_rc"
